gap: No result ChatGPT got states the price per Wh or the hours of full sun to refill for the BLUETTI Elite 400 or ALLPOWERS R3500 kits: Elite 400 + 2× 200 W is $0.470/Wh at the link price against $0.757/Wh for the EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 + 400 W kit ChatGPT picked, and no kit near 4,000 Wh refills from its own panels in under about 5.3 hours of full sun at rated output.
standout_why: Compared against PowerSized's DELTA Pro 3 review (cited), StormWatts' 240 V solar-input page (cited), StormWatts' bundle-vs-separate page (cited) and StormWatts' same-panel-watts kit page (in results, not cited). PowerSized has station-only prices and no kit price or solar refill figure. The StormWatts pages do have the method (price per kWh, share refilled on a 4.5-sun-hour day) and figures for the DELTA Pro 3 and HomePower 3600 Plus kits, so the method is not new. None of the four mentions the Elite 400 or the R3500, so the per-Wh and refill figures for those kits, and the side-by-side with the DELTA Pro 3 kit, are new.
decides: It moves the value pick off ChatGPT's DELTA Pro 3 + 400 W ($3,099, kits out of stock at EcoFlow per PowerSized on Nov 17). The Elite 400 + 2× 200 W gives 94% of the battery for $1,804.05 through our link (store $1,899.00), 38% less per Wh, with about the same refill (9.6 h against 10.2 h), but it is a pre-order for mid-January 2027. No kit I could verify inside 3,200-4,800 Wh ships now: Jackery's station is a pre-order to Dec 15, and Anker's F3800 Plus is sold out. The ship-now pick therefore depends on admitting the R3500 at 3,168 Wh (20.8% under 4,000): R3500 + SP039 600 W at $1,753.93 link (store $1,993.10) is $0.554/Wh and 5.3 h, the fastest refill here. R3500 + SP037 400 W at $1,586.73 link (store $1,803.10) is the cheaper ship-now kit at $0.501/Wh and 7.9 h. For a shopper who can wait and wants a one-and-a-bit-day refill, Elite 400 + 2× 350 W is $0.606/Wh and 5.5 h.

findings.label: Maker's own statement of real output for this polycrystalline panel, and the refill it implies
findings.value: 55-65 W per 100 W rated, so 220-260 W; R3500 refill 12.2-14.4 h
findings.source_title: ALLPOWERS Solar Generator Kit 2400W (S2000 Pro + SP037 400W Solar Panel)
findings.note: The statement ('a 100W solar panel can output about 55W-65W') is on the S2000 Pro + SP037 listing, not the R3500 one, and concerns the same SP037 panel. 400 × 0.55 = 220 W, 400 × 0.65 = 260 W; 3,168 ÷ 260 = 12.2 h, 3,168 ÷ 220 = 14.4 h.
